subject: Urgent: Latency regression after model-7q rollout — rollback/exception request
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <ops@quanticahealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sudden p95 jump after model-7q goes live (Quantica production)

Hi Sean / Monica,

Quick heads up — we saw a sharp increase in inference latency starting at ~08:45 PST this morning right after model-7q became the default variant for our prod route. Our dashboards show p95 jumping from ~120ms to ~1.6s and a noticeable drop in throughput.

We pulled traces and attached a CSV with p50/p95 samples across the last 3 hours. We also attached a CloudWatch screenshot. This is impacting patient-facing flows; clinical teams are reporting timeouts.

Can Redwood revert Quantica to the previous model variant (7p) for our dedicated pool, or grant a temporary SLO relaxation while you investigate? We need either an immediate rollback or a documented exception for the SLA window.

Attaching: quantica-p95-deltas-20270105.csv, screenshot-cloudwatch-p95-07q.png

Thanks,
Jordan Miles
Ops Lead, Quantica Health
ops@quanticahealth.com

--
Quantica Health
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <ops@quanticahealth.com>, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 jump after model-7q goes live (Quantica production)

Hi Jordan — thanks for the data, and sorry for the interruption. We see the same delta on our side (I pulled the tenant-level traces).

Immediate plan I propose:
- Scoped rollback for Quantica's dedicated pool to variant 7p (isolated to your account) — requires leadership approval for a targeted variant revert.
- While rollback proceeds, open an incident postmortem and preserve KV cache snapshots for debugging.
- If rollback isn’t possible within 30 minutes, request temporary SLA exception for p95 for the affected routes (we can propose a window and exact language).

I’m looping Sean and Vivek for rollback approval and Laura for legal/contract note (just in case we need formal SLA amendment language).

Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0119

Thanks for the signal, Monica.

Approve a scoped rollback for Quantica to variant 7p immediately — this should be a targeted action, no global rollback. Product/infra: please execute a per-tenant traffic switch and validate warmup for 7p; keep 7q as the default for others until we root-cause.

Operational notes for the rollout team (cc infra):
- Perform rollback toggle at 09:55 PST.
- Monitor p95 and error rate for 20 minutes post-rollback; escalate if p95 does not return within 2x baseline.
- Capture KV cache samples and a copy of the canary logs (attach canary-rollout-log-7q.txt).

Monica — coordinate the exception language to send to Quantica for their records (one-page memo, start/end times, impact summary). Laura — if there’s any contractual wording we need for a formal SLO exception, please advise.

Vivek
CTO, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <ops@quanticahealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 jump after model-7q goes live (Quantica production)

Jordan — we rolled Quantica back to 7p at 09:56 PST as approved.

Summary of actions taken:
- Targeted variant switch completed for Quantica's dedicated pool (deployment toggle: https://redwood.console/deployments/model-7q/rollbacks).
- Observed p95 returning to baseline (~130ms) within 9 minutes post-rollback. See attached canary-rollout-log-7q.txt for the operation log.
- Incident declared and postmortem scheduled; Monica will share the incident summary and the proposed temporary SLA exception memo by EOD.

Next steps for Quantica ops:
- Please confirm whether the recovery restored normal UX for your clinical flows.
- We'll keep a provisional exception window logged: 09:45–10:20 PST (requested for your records). If you need formal contract language, Laura will follow up.

Sorry for the disruption — we’ll prioritize root cause (kernel selection differences under the new quantized kernels looks likely) and share mitigations.

Sean Gallagher
VP, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0199
